# MIT Technology Review

> MIT Technology Review covers emerging technologies shaping the future, from AI and climate tech to quantum computing and biotech, with editorial collections, breaking news, and expert analysis.

MIT Technology Review is a leading publication from MIT that provides in-depth reporting on technological innovation and its impact on society. The site features news, magazines, events, and curated topic collections that help readers understand the most important technological developments.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence
- Climate Tech
- Quantum Computing
- Biotechnology
- Large Language Models
- 10 Breakthrough Technologies
- 35 Innovators Under 35
- OpenAI
- ChatGPT
- MIT
- 10 Climate Tech Companies to Watch
- Innovation Coverage
- Technology Trends
- Research & Development
- Emerging Technologies

## Core Content & Discovery

- [MIT Technology Review Homepage](https://www.technologyreview.com): Homepage featuring emerging tech news on AI, climate, biotech, and quantum computing
- [All Topics Directory](https://www.technologyreview.com/all-topics): Topic directory with editorial collections like 10 Breakthrough Technologies and curated technology categories
- [About MIT Technology Review](https://www.technologyreview.com/supertopic/about-mit-technology-review): Organization overview describing MIT Technology Review's mission and editorial platforms

## Featured Magazine & Special Issues

- [The Crime Issue](https://www.technologyreview.com/magazines/the-crime-issue): Magazine feature on AI scams, cybersecurity, blockchain, and crime technology
- [A Boost for Manufacturing](https://www.technologyreview.com/magazines/a-boost-for-manufacturing): Feature article on MIT's Initiative for New Manufacturing and US industry advocacy

## Events & Conferences

- [Events Hub](https://events.technologyreview.com): Conference and events hub featuring EmTech AI, ClimateTech, and executive roundtables

## Newsletters & Subscriptions

- [Newsletter Preferences](https://www.technologyreview.com/newsletter-preferences): Newsletter signup and email preference management for daily and weekly digests
- [The Spark: Climate-Tech Newsletter](https://forms.technologyreview.com/newsletters/climate-energy-the-spark): Weekly climate-tech newsletter signup explaining solutions to the climate crisis
